data.title: Keep a reusable project brief and decision log
data.summary: Carry an ongoing personal or team project across focused chats without losing the source of decisions.

facts.text: ChatGPT projects collect chats, files, instructions and sources. A ChatGPT project is distinct from a local project and does not itself grant access to a computer folder.

prerequisites: Access to ChatGPT Projects; check account, client and workspace availability.
Find the current project and its brief, source list and instructions.
steps: Inspect the existing project and source inventory before adding context.
Replace conflicting instructions with one short current brief while preserving the decision history.
Use a focused chat for one outcome; reference the authoritative source versions.
At a milestone, record decisions with rationale, owner, date and source.
Start a follow-up chat and check whether it can reconstruct the objective and open questions from the project material.
data.output: a current project brief, source inventory and handoff log
validation: Ask which version is authoritative; do not silently merge incompatible decisions.
Request an authorized upload/connection rather than claiming it was inspected.
limitations: Sintra-authored procedure based on provider documentation or demonstrations; no execution in the named app was performed.
Availability and results depend on your inputs, enabled tools and permissions; a suggested practice result is not a measured outcome.
data.prompt: In [existing project], inspect [current brief, sources and decision log] before creating anything. Update the authoritative brief for [objective] using the latest approved decisions. Keep a dated history and source links; distinguish goals, decisions, assumptions and unresolved questions. Flag conflicting versions. Return a compact handoff that another chat can use to reconstruct the current state. Do not claim to read local folders unless access is actually available.
tips: Put stable preferences in instructions and volatile facts in dated sources.
A handoff should say what is unresolved, not just what was completed.
